title: 日本語の森 N3 — 日本社会の特徴 (Features of Japanese Society)
description: From 日本語の森. This N3 lesson uses a reading passage about features of Japanese society — group orientation (集団主義), the concept of 'reading the air' (空気を読む), work culture (残業), and the seniority system (年功序列). Lesson is conducted entirely in Japanese at N3 reading speed.
